title: vocab@1: a language's vocabulary decks
description: languages/<id>/vocab.jsonl. The first line is the header, naming the language and its decks in teaching order; every later line is one word, in teaching order within its deck.

language.description: The language (or variety) id; must match the folder.

notes.description: How the words are written and where they come from, one sentence or line each.

source.description: For imported words: the source, as listed in SOURCES.md.

license.description: For imported words: the source's license.

id.description: Unique in the file: the deck id, a slash, and the word.

word.description: The word as it is usually written.

reading.description: Romanization or kana reading. Languages written in the Latin alphabet leave it out.

meaning.description: English meaning; alternatives separated by semicolons.

level.description: Level in each system that grades the word, e.g. {"jlpt": "N5"}, {"hsk": "1"}, {"cefr": "A1"}.

varieties.description: Varieties the word belongs to, when it isn't the standard language's.
